lines.en: How did Sam get his money back?
lines.cn: 萨姆是怎么把钱拿回来的？

lines.en: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
lines.cn: 整个村庄很快都知道有一大笔钱丢失了。
山姆·本顿，当地的肉铺老板……

lines.en: had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
lines.cn: 他在去邮局存钱的时候丢失了钱包。

lines.en: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers,
lines.cn: 萨姆确信那个钱包一定是被某个村民找到的。

lines.en: but it was not returned to him.
lines.cn: 但是，那个东西并没有被归还给他。

lines.en: Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
lines.cn: 三个月过去了，一天早晨，山姆发现他的钱包放在自家前门外面。

lines.en: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost,
lines.cn: 它被用报纸包了起来，里面装着他丢失的钱的一半。

lines.en: together with a note which said:
lines.cn: 还附有一张纸条，上面写着：

lines.en: 'A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!'
lines.cn: “他确实是个小偷，但只能算是个‘50%的小偷’罢了！”

lines.en: some more money was sent to Sam with another note:
lines.cn: 又有一些钱被寄给了萨姆，并附上了一张便条。

lines.en: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
lines.cn: 随着时间的推移，山姆的所有钱都通过这种方式被还清了。

lines.en: The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
lines.cn: 最后一张纸条上写着：“现在我100%是诚实的了！”
